text: Live-tree evidence narrows two Phase-0 gates: Cats Effect 3.5.4 is already cross-platform in image and Async/Resource/EitherT are used by BIDS JVM, so D1 defaults to shared Cats Effect admission and tests Scala.js cleanup/cancellation/cost. DMat already proves cross-platform row-major NArray ownership adoption, but its public mutable data field disqualifies direct reuse for ResponseBlock; D2 chooses a private primitive carrier and adapter transfer rules, not a tensor abstraction.
